witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I watched a man in a red shirt point a gun at a man in a blue hoodie. The man in red ran into the counter, collected the money, and ran away. The cashier walked to the counter and kept handing money to the man in blue. A person nearby operated the cash register and collected the money.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man who robbed the place. He ran into the counter and pointed a gun at the man in red. I'm pretty sure he raised a gun from time to time to threaten the man in red and collected the money. Another man, wearing a white shirt, walked to the cashier and operated the cash register. He kept handing money to the man in blue. I'm not sure if the person nearby operated the cash register or ran away.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who ran into the counter and raised a gun from time to time to threaten the man in red. The man in red walked to the cashier and kept handing money to the man in blue. A person nearby operated and collected the money. I'm not sure if there was a knife involved.
